title: Universitetga hujjat topshirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz xorijiy universitetga hujjat topshirishning barcha bosqichlarini ingliz tilida ishonch bilan o‘tasiz: dastur va qabul lug‘atini bilasiz, kerakli hujjatlar to‘plamini tayyorlaysiz, qabul bo‘limiga professional enquiry xat yozasiz hamda muddatlar va sanalarni aniq ifodalaysiz.
homework_uz: Qabul bo‘limiga enquiry xat yozing: mavzu satrida dastur nomi va qabul mavsumi, birinchi jumlada kim ekanligingiz va qaysi dasturga qiziqayotganingiz, so‘ng kamida uchta aniq savol (kirish talablari, stipendiya, oxirgi muddat) va rasmiy yopilish bo‘lsin; xat 150 so‘zdan oshmasin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘qisangiz, xatni bir daqiqada tugatib bo‘ladi, har bir savol alohida jumla va javob berish oson. Keyingi dars: P1-15 Grant va motivatsion xat.

vocab.uz: stipendiya / grant — o‘qish to‘lovini qoplaydigan yordam
qabul — universitetga kirish jarayoni va natijasi
shartli qabul xati — talablar bajarilsa qabul qilinasiz
baholar qaydnomasi — reyting daftarining rasmiy nusxasi
maqsad xati — nima uchun shu dastur ekanligingizni yozasiz
tavsiyanoma — o‘qituvchi yoki rahbar tomonidan yoziladi
oxirgi muddat — bundan keyin ariza qabul qilinmaydi
so‘ramoq — enquire (UK), inquire (US); xatlarda enquire for nature of the question

scenes.title: Xorijiy universitetga hujjat topshirishga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda ijara va kommunal xizmatlarni o‘rgandik — ijara e’lonini o‘qish, shartnoma shartlari va uy egasiga xabar yozish. Bugun mavzuyimiz kattaroq: xorijiy universitetga hujjat topshirish. Har yili minglab o‘zbekistonlik yoshlar Buyuk Britaniya, Turkiya va AQShdagi dasturlarga ariza topshiradi, lekin ko‘pchilik inglizcha xat yozishda yoki hujjatlar to‘plamida yiqiladi. Bugun bu jarayonni boshidan oxirigacha bosib o‘tamiz — so‘zlovdan enquiry xatgacha.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson was renting a flat and council-style paperwork. Today we tackle the big one: applying to a university abroad. Every year thousands of Uzbek applicants apply to UK, Turkish and US programmes — and many stumble on the paperwork or the writing. By the end of this lesson, the whole process is in your hands.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda ijara masalasini o‘rgandik. Bugun esa eng katta mavzulardan biri: xorijiy universitetga hujjat topshirish. Har yili minglab o‘zbekistonlik talabalar Britaniya, Turkiya va AQSh dasturlariga ariza topshiradi, ko‘pchilik esa hujjatlar yoki yozuvda qiynaladi. Dars oxirida bu jarayon to‘liq sizning qo‘lingizda bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Programme va admission atamalari

examples.t: The programme is a two-year MSc taught in English.
examples.uz: Dastur — ikki yillik magistrlik, ingliz tilida o‘qitiladi.

examples.t: Tuition fees are paid per academic year.
examples.uz: O‘qish to‘lovi o‘quv yili bo‘yicha to‘lanadi.

scenes.say_native: Boshlaymiz lug‘atdan. Programme — bu o‘quv dasturining o‘zi: butun kurs majmuasi. Admission — universitetning sizni qabul qilish yoki qilmaslik jarayoni va natijasi. Tuition fee — o‘qish to‘lovi, odatda o‘quv yili bo‘yicha yoziladi. Scholarship — universitet yoki fond tomonidan beriladigan stipendiya, ko‘pincha merit-based, ya’ni a’lo baholar uchun. Conditional offer — shartli qabul xati: agar yakuniy baholaringiz yoki IELTS ballingiz talabni qondirsa, joyingiz sizniki. Intake — qabul mavsumi: September intake — kuzgi, January intake — qishki to‘plam.
scenes.say: Key words first. Programme is the course itself — the full study package. Admission is the process and result of being accepted. Tuition fee is the annual cost. A scholarship is money awarded for merit or need. A conditional offer means you're in, provided your final grades or IELTS meet the threshold. The intake is the start season — September intake is the autumn cohort, January the winter one.
scenes.say_uz: Avval atamalar. Programme — o‘quv dasturining o‘zi. Admission — qabul jarayoni va natijasi. Tuition fee — yillik o‘qish to‘lovi. Scholarship — merit yoki ehtiyoj uchun beriladigan stipendiya. Conditional offer — yakuniy baholaringiz yoki IELTS talabni qondirsa, joy sizniki bo‘ladi degan shartli qabul. Intake — qabul mavsumi: September intake — kuzgi, January intake — qishki to‘plam.

scenes.title: Dastur turlari: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD
board: Undergraduate: Bachelor of Arts (BA) / Bachelor of Science (BSc)
Postgraduate: Master of Arts (MA) / Master of Science (MSc)
Joint honours = ikki fan birga; major/minor (US)

examples.t: I completed my bachelor's degree in Economics last year.
examples.uz: Men o‘tgan yili iqtisodiyot bo‘yicha bakalavr darajasini oldim.

examples.t: She is doing a two-year MSc in Data Science.
examples.uz: U ikki yillik Data Science magistrlik dasturida o‘qiyapti.

scenes.say_native: Darajalarni chalkashtirmang. Undergraduate bosqich — bakalavr: Britaniyada uch-to‘rtta yil, BA yoki BSc bilan tugaydi. Postgraduate — bakalavrdan keyin: MA yoki MSc — bir-ikki yillik magistratura; PhD — uch-besh yillik mustaqil tadqiqot, natijada dissertatsiya yozib himoya qilasiz. Britaniyada 'joint honours' — ikki fan barobar o‘qiladi, masalan Economics and Politics. AQShda esa major — asosiy fan, minor — qo‘shimcha fan. ECTS — Yevropa kredit tizimi; master'da odatda 90 yoki 120 kredit.
scenes.say: Don't mix the levels up. Undergraduate is bachelor: three or four years, BA or BSc. Postgraduate comes after: MA or MSc — a one- or two-year master's; PhD is three to five years of independent research ending in a defended dissertation. In Britain a joint honours degree pairs two subjects, like Economics and Politics. In the US you declare a major — your main field — and optionally a minor. One master's year usually equals 60 or more ECTS credits.
scenes.say_uz: Darajalarni chalkashtirmang. Undergraduate — bakalavr: Britaniyada uch-to‘rt yil, BA yoki BSc. Postgraduate — keyingi bosqich: MA yoki MSc, bir-ikki yillik magistratura; PhD — uch-besh yillik mustaqil tadqiqot va himoya. Britaniyada joint honours — ikki fan birga, masalan Economics and Politics. AQShda major — asosiy fan, minor — qo‘shimcha. Bir yil master'da odatda 60 yoki undan ko‘proq ECTS kredit.

scenes.title: Namuna: universitet broshyura matni
scenes.say_native: Endi real broshyura tilini o‘qing. Universitetlar matni rasmiy, aniq va shartlarga to‘la: nima talab qilinadi, qancha to‘lanadi, qachon ariza topshiriladi. Har bir jumlani alohida qism deb o‘qing: talab — requirements, to‘lov — fees, muddat — deadline. Diqqat qiling, 'entry requirements' iborasi har doim ko‘plikda; 'tuition fee' esa odatda birlik yoki ko‘plikda kelishi mumkin, ikkovi ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: We welcome applications for the MSc in Computer Science, September 2027 intake. Entry requirements: a bachelor's degree in a related field with a minimum of 60 percent overall, plus IELTS 6.5, no band lower than 6.0. Tuition fees for international students are £18,500 per year. Merit-based scholarships of up to 50 percent are available. Application deadline: 30 June 2027. Late applications are not considered.
scenes.say_uz: We welcome applications for the MSc in Computer Science, September 2027 intake. Entry requirements — Kirish talablari: aloqa soha bakalavr darajasi, o‘rtacha kamida 60 foiz, hamda IELTS 6.5, hech bir band 6.0 dan past emas. Tuition fees — xorijiy talabalar uchun £18,500 yiliga. Merit-based scholarships — 50 foizgacha. Application deadline — 30 June 2027. Late applications are not considered — kechikkan arizalar ko‘rib chiqilmaydi.

scenes.title: Kerakli hujjatlar to‘plami

examples.t: Please submit certified copies of your degree certificate.

scenes.say_native: Endi hujjatlar. Yettita asosiy hujjat bor. Passport — kamida olti oy amal qilishi shart. Transcript — baholar qaydnomasi, odatda ingliz tiliga rasmiy tarjima bilan. Diplom yoki sertifikat — nusxasi, ko‘pincha tasdiqlangan. Ingliz tili sinovi — IELTS yoki TOEFL, natijalari to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri universitetga yuboriladi. Personal statement — nima uchun shu dastur, nega aynan shu universitet. Ikki tavsiyanoma — biri ilmiy rahbardan, biri ish beruvchidan. Ba’zi dasturlar CV ham so‘raydi.
scenes.say: The seven core documents. Passport — valid for at least six months. Transcript — official grades, with certified translation if not in English. Degree or certificate — certified copy. English test result — IELTS or TOEFL, sent directly by the test centre. Personal statement — why this programme, why this university. Two references — one academic, one professional. Some programmes also ask for a CV or résumé.
scenes.say_uz: Etti asosiy hujjat. Passport — kamida olti oy amal qilishi shart. Transcript — rasmiy baholar, ingliz tilida bo‘lmasa tasdiqlangan tarjima bilan. Diplom yoki sertifikat — tasdiqlangan nusxa. Ingliz tili testi — IELTS yoki TOEFL, natija sinov markazidan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri yuboriladi. Personal statement — nega aynan shu dastur. Ikki tavsiyanoma — biri akademik, biri ish beruvchidan. Ba’zi dasturlar CV ham so‘raydi.

scenes.title: Tasdiqlash: certified, notarised, apostille
board: Certified copy = muhrlangan nusxa, asl bilan bir xil

examples.t: The documents must be certified by a notary and translated.
examples.uz: Hujjatlar notarial tasdiqlanishi va tarjima qilinishi kerak.

scenes.say_native: Hujjatlarni o‘z-o‘zidan yuborib bo‘lmaydi — ko‘pchiligi tasdiqlanishi shart. Certified copy — muhrlangan nusxa: notarius yoki universitet diplomning asl nusxasi bilan bir xil ekanligini tasdiqlaydi. Notarised — notarial tasdiq, ya’ni notarial idoraga muhrlatasiz. Apostille — xalqaro tasdiq muhri: agar diplom boshqa davlatda ishlatilishi kerak bo‘lsa, Haaqa konvensiyasi mamlakatlarida apostille qo‘yiladi — buni adliya vazirligi yoki tashqi ishlar amalga oshiradi. Tarjimani esa faqat rasmiy tarjimon qilishi va imzolashi kerak.
scenes.say: You can't just scan and send — most documents need certifying. A certified copy carries an official stamp confirming it matches the original — usually from a notary or your university. Notarised simply means signed and stamped by a notary. An apostille is the international certification stamp used between Hague Convention countries — arranged through the ministry of justice. And any translation must be done by an official, sworn translator.
scenes.say_uz: Hujjatlarni skanerlab yuborib bo‘lmaydi — aksariyati tasdiqlanishi shart. Certified copy — nusxa asl bilan bir xil ekanini tasdiqlovchi rasmiy muhr, odatda notarial yoki universitet muhri. Notarised — notarius tomonidan imzolangan va muhrlangan. Apostille — Haaqa konvensiyasi mamlakatlari orasidagi xalqaro tasdiq muhri, adliya vazirligi orqali rasmiylashtiriladi. Tarjimani faqat rasmiy, jured tarjimon qilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Enquiry xati: ohang va ochilish
board: Subject: Enquiry — MSc Computer Science (Sept 2027 intake)

examples.t: I am writing to enquire about entry requirements for your MSc.
examples.uz: Sizning MSc dasturingiz kirish talablari haqida so‘rash uchun yozyapman.

scenes.say_native: Endi yurak qismi — enquiry xat. Avval ohang: muloyim, qisqa, aniq. Mavzu satrida dastur nomi va intake'ni yozing — qabul bo‘limi yuzlab xat oladi, mavzusiz xat yo‘qoladi. Birinchi jumla: 'I am writing to enquire about…' — 'enquire' Britaniya imlosi, 'inquire' Amerika. Keyin o‘zingizni qisqacha tanishtiring: kimsiz, qayerdan, qaysi kursga qiziqasiz. Savollarni alohida jumla yoki ro‘yxat qiling — qabul xodimi ularni birma-bir javoblaydi.
scenes.say: Now the heart of it — the enquiry email. Tone: polite, short, precise. Subject line: programme name plus intake — admissions teams read hundreds of emails a day, and a vague subject loses yours. First sentence: 'I am writing to enquire about…' — enquire in British English, inquire in American. Then a one-line introduction: who you are, where from, which programme. Then your questions, each in its own sentence or as a short numbered list.
scenes.say_uz: Endi eng muhim qism — enquiry xat. Ohang: muloyim, qisqa, aniq. Mavzu satrida dastur nomi va intake'ni yozing — qabul bo‘limi kuniga yuzlab xat oladi. Birinchi jumla: 'I am writing to enquire about…' — Britaniyada enquire, Amerikada inquire. Keyin bir qator tanishtiruv: kimsiz, qayerdan, qaysi dastur. So‘ng savollar — har biri alohida jumla yoki qisqa ro‘yxat.

scenes.title: Body: maqsad, savollar, yopilish
board: Closing: 'I look forward to hearing from you.'

examples.t: Could you please confirm the tuition fee for international students?
examples.uz: Xorijiy talabalar uchun o‘qish to‘lovini tasdiqlab bera olasizmi?

examples.t: Would it be possible to defer my place to next year?
examples.uz: Joyimni keyingi yilga qoldirish imkoniyati bormi?

scenes.say_native: Xat tanasi uch qismdan iborat. Birinchi qism — kirish: 'My name is Jasur Tokhtayev, I am a final-year economics student at Tashkent State University…' — ikki jumla yetadi. Ikkinchi qism — savollar, har biri alohida qatorda: birinchi — kirish talablari; ikkinchi — stipendiya yoki moddiy yordam; uchinchi — oxirgi muddat va keyingi intake. Uchinchi qism — yopilish: 'I look forward to hearing from you.' va ismi-sharifingiz. So‘rovlarni 'Could you please…' yoki 'Would it be possible…' bilan boshlang — ingliz tilida buyruq ohangi qabul qilinmaydi.
scenes.say: The body, three parts. Opening: 'I am a final-year economics student at Tashkent State University…' — two sentences are plenty. Questions, one per line: entry requirements; funding or scholarship options; the deadline and next available intake. Closing: 'I look forward to hearing from you' plus your name. Start every ask with 'Could you please…' or 'Would it be possible…' — bare imperatives feel rude in English.
scenes.say_uz: Tananing uch qismi. Kirish: 'I am a final-year economics student at Tashkent State University…' — ikki jumla kifoya. Savollar, har biri alohida qatorda: kirish talablari; stipendiya yoki moliyaviy yordam; oxirgi muddat va keyingi intake. Yopilish: 'I look forward to hearing from you' va ismingiz. Har bir so‘rovni 'Could you please…' yoki 'Would it be possible…' bilan boshlang — buyruq ohangi ingliz tilida qo‘pol tuyiladi.

scenes.title: Namuna: to‘liq enquiry xat
scenes.say_native: Endi namunani boshidan oxirigacha o‘qing. Mavzu satri, salom, bir jumlalik kimligingiz, uch savol va yopilish. Qabul xodimi uchun javob berish oson — shu maqsad. Xato qilmanglar: o‘z-o‘zini maqtash sig‘maydi, faqat aniq savollar.
scenes.say: Subject: Enquiry — MSc Environmental Science, September 2027 intake. Dear Admissions Team, I am writing to enquire about the above programme. My name is Dilnoza Karimova, a final-year geography student at Tashkent State University. Could you confirm the entry requirements for international applicants? Also, are merit-based scholarships available? And what is the deadline — is there a January intake? I look forward to your reply. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: Enquiry — Environmental Science MSc, September 2027 intake. Dear Admissions Team — hurmatli qabul bo‘limi. 'I am writing to enquire about the above programme' — yuqoridagi dastur haqida so‘rash uchun yozyapman. Kim ekanligi: Dilnoza Karimova, Toshkent Davlat Universitetining oxirgi kurs geografiya talabasi. Uch savol: kirish talablari; merit-based stipendiyalar; oxirgi muddat va January intake. 'Yours sincerely' — chunki adresat noma’lum jamoaviy inbox, Yours faithfully ham mumkin.

scenes.title: Mavzu satri va ochilishni yozing
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizning stsenariyingiz: tanlangan dasturingiz uchun mavzu satri va birinchi jumlani yozing. Mavzu satrida dastur nomi va intake ko‘rinsin. Birinchi jumla 'I am writing to enquire about…' formatida. Yigirma soniya — ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Your turn. For your chosen programme, draft the subject line and your opening sentence. Subject: programme name plus intake, six to eight words. Opening: 'I am writing to enquire about…'. Twenty seconds, out loud.
scenes.say_uz: Endi o‘zingiz. Tanlangan dasturingiz uchun mavzu satri va ochilishni yozing. Mavzu: dastur nomi va intake, olti-sakkiz so‘z. Ochish: 'I am writing to enquire about…'. Yigirma soniya, ovoz chiqarib.

scenes.title: Javoblar: mavzu va ochilish

examples.t: Enquiry — MSc Data Science (Sept 2027 intake) — Dilnoza Karimova
examples.uz: Enquiry — MSc Data Science (sentyabr 2027 qabuli) — Dilnoza Karimova.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Kuchli mavzu satri: 'Enquiry — MSc Data Science (Sept 2027 intake)' — dastur, intake va so‘rovning mazmuni bir qarashda ko‘rinadi. Yomon mavzu: 'Hello', 'Question' yoki 'Important' — bunday xatlar chetga suriladi. Ochilish jumlada uch element: kim ekanligingiz, qayerdan va nima so‘rayotganingiz. 'I am writing to enquire about the entry requirements and scholarship options for the MSc Data Science programme.' — bir jumla, uch savol yo‘nalishi.
scenes.say: Answers. Strong subject: 'Enquiry — MSc Data Science (Sept 2027 intake)' — programme, intake, purpose, one glance. Weak: 'Hello', 'Question', 'Important' — those get skipped. The opening sentence carries three elements: who you are, where from, what you want. 'I am writing to enquire about the entry requirements and scholarship options for the MSc Data Science programme.' One sentence, clear direction.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Kuchli mavzu: 'Enquiry — MSc Data Science (Sept 2027 intake)' — dastur, intake, maqsad. Zaif mavzu: 'Hello', 'Question', 'Important' — bular e’tiborga olinmaydi. Ochilish jumlada uch element: kim, qayerdan, nima so‘rasiz. 'I am writing to enquire about the entry requirements and scholarship options for the MSc Data Science programme.' — bir jumla, aniq yo‘nalish.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: qabul bo‘limiga qo‘ng‘iroq
scenes.say_native: Tinglash qismi. Talaba Dilnoza telefon orqali qabul bo‘limiga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoqda. Sizga to‘rtta savol bo‘ladi — raqamlarga, sanalarga va shartlarga e’tibor bering. Admissions officer juda tez gapiradi, lekin asosiy faktlar takrorlanadi. Boshlaymiz.
scenes.say: Officer: Good morning, admissions office. Student: This is Dilnoza from Tashkent — I'm calling about the MSc in Data Science. Officer: Which intake? Student: September 2027. Officer: Entry requirements: a bachelor's degree, at least 60 percent average, IELTS 6.5. Student: And the fee? Officer: £19,200 per year for international students. Student: Is there a scholarship? Officer: Yes — merit awards up to 40 percent. Student: And the deadline? Officer: Apply by 30 June 2027.
scenes.say_uz: Officer: Good morning, admissions office — xayrli tong, qabul bo‘limi. Student: Good morning, this is Dilnoza from Tashkent — xayrli tong, men Toshkentdan Dilnozaman, Data Science MSc dasturi bo‘yicha qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapman. Officer: Of course — qaysi intake? Student: September 2027. Officer: Entry requirements — kamida 60 foiz o‘rtacha baho va IELTS 6.5, past band 6 dan yo‘q. Student: To‘lov qancha? Officer: Xalqaro talabalar uchun yiliga £19,200. Student: Stipendiya bormi? Officer: Ha, merit asosida 40 foizgacha. Student: Muddat? Officer: 30 June 2027 gacha ariza topshiring.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol: qaysi intake haqida gapirildi? IELTS talabi qanday? Yillik tuition fee qancha? Merit stipendiya necha foizgacha qoplanadi? Har birini raqam bilan ayting. Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: which intake is discussed? Two: what is the IELTS requirement? Three: what is the annual tuition fee? Four: how much can the merit scholarship cover? Answer with numbers. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol: bir — qaysi intake? Ikki — IELTS talabi? Uch — yillik tuition fee? To‘rt — merit stipendiya necha foizgacha? Raqamlar bilan javob bering. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
board: 2) IELTS 6.5, hech bir band 6 dan past
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: bir — September 2027 intake. Ikki — IELTS 6.5, hech bir band 6.0 dan past bo‘lmasligi kerak. Uch — yilliga £19,200, ya’ni funtyaka to‘qson to‘qqiz yuz ikki yuz funt. To‘rt — merit stipendiya 40 foizgacha. Agar raqamlarni chalkashtirgan bo‘lsangiz, audio qismni qayta tinglab, har bir raqamni yozib boring — raqamlar uchun bu eng yaxshi mashq.
scenes.say: Answers. One: September 2027 intake. Two: IELTS 6.5, no band below 6.0. Three: £19,200 per year. Four: merit scholarships up to 40 percent. Missed the numbers? Re-listen and write each figure down — numbers demand repetition.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: bir — September 2027 intake. Ikki — IELTS 6.5, hech bir band 6.0 dan past emas. Uch — yiliga £19,200. To‘rt — merit stipendiya 40 foizgacha. Raqamlarni chalkashtirgan bo‘lsangiz, qayta tinglab yozib oling.

scenes.title: Muddatlar: ‘no later than’, ‘by’, ‘ahead of’
board: 'no later than 30 June' — 30 iyundan kech emas
'by Friday' = jumagacha (shu kunni ham o‘z ichiga oladi)
'in time for September intake' = sentyabrga yetib boradi

examples.t: Applications must be received no later than 30 June.
examples.uz: Arizalar 30 iyundan kech bo‘lmaganda qabul qilinishi kerak.

examples.t: Submit your documents ahead of the deadline.

scenes.say_native: Muddatlar bilan ishlash — ariza muvaffaqiyatining yarmi. 'No later than 30 June' — 30 iyun kuni soat 23:59 gacha, undan bir soniya kech bo‘lsa ham qabul qilinmaydi. 'By Friday' — jumagacha, shu kuni ham hisobga kiritilgan. 'Ahead of the deadline' — muddatdan oldin, hech bo‘lmaganda bir hafta oldin topshirish maqsadga muvofiq. Yodingizda bo‘lsin: ariza topshirilgandan keyin ham hujjatlar to‘liq bo‘lishi kerak — to‘liqsiz ariza ko‘rib chiqilmaydi.
scenes.say: Deadlines decide everything. 'No later than 30 June' means 23:59 on 30 June — one second late and it's rejected. 'By Friday' includes Friday itself. 'Ahead of the deadline' means before it — aim a week early. Remember: applying early is not enough; your file must be complete — incomplete applications aren't reviewed at all.
scenes.say_uz: Muddatlar hamma narsa. 'No later than 30 June' — 30 iyun soat 23:59 gacha. 'By Friday' — juma kuni ham kiradi. 'Ahead of the deadline' — muddatdan oldin, bir hafta oldin topshiring. Yodda tuting: erta topshirish yetarli emas — to‘liqsiz fayl ko‘rib chiqilmaydi.

scenes.title: Intake'lar va British sana formati
board: UK: September intake = autumn; US: fall semester

examples.t: I plan to start in the 2027 September intake.

scenes.say_native: Sanalar ikki xil yoziladi. Britaniyada '8 November 2026' — avval kun, keyin oy, keyin yil, barchasi so‘z bilan. Amerikada 'November 8, 2026' — avval oy. Chalkashtirib yubormaslik uchun har doim oy nomini so‘z bilan yozing — '11/07/2026' ingliz tilida ham 7-noyabr, ham 11-iyul deb o‘qilishi mumkin. Intake'lar: Britaniyada September yoki January; Amerikada fall (kuz) va spring (bahor) semesterlari. Ariza topshirish odatda intake'dan 9-12 oy oldin ochiladi.
scenes.say: Two date conventions. Britain: 8 November 2026 — day, month, year, all in words. The US: November 8, 2026 — month first. To avoid ambiguity, always write the month as a word; 11/07/2026 can mean either. Intakes: Britain runs September and January; the US runs fall and spring semesters. Applications typically open nine to twelve months before the intake.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki sana konvensiyasi. Britaniya: 8 November 2026 — kun, oy, yil. AQSh: November 8, 2026 — avval oy. Chalkashmaslik uchun oy doim so‘z bilan yozing; 11/07/2026 ikki xil o‘qiladi. Intake: Britaniyada September va January; AQShda fall va spring semesterlari. Arizalar intake'dan 9-12 oy oldin ochiladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: sana gaplar
board: 'I must apply no later than 30 June 2027.'
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. 'Applications close on 30 June 2027.' — 'close on' dan keyin to‘liq sana. 'The programme starts in September 2027.' — oy va yil oldidan 'in' ishlatiladi. 'I must apply no later than 30 June 2027.' — yoki sodda variant: 'by 30 June 2027'. Xato variantlar: 'in 30 June', 'on September 2027' — oy va yil bilan 'in', kun bilan 'on'.
scenes.say: Answers. 'Applications close on 30 June 2027.' — 'on' with a full date. 'The programme starts in September 2027.' — 'in' with month and year. 'I must apply no later than 30 June 2027' — or simply 'by 30 June 2027'. Common errors: 'in 30 June', 'on September 2027' — months take 'in', days take 'on'.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. 'Applications close on 30 June 2027.' — to‘liq kun oldidan 'on'. 'The programme starts in September 2027.' — oy va yil oldidan 'in'. 'I must apply no later than 30 June 2027' yoki sodda 'by 30 June 2027'. Xato: 'in 30 June', 'on September 2027' — kun oldidan 'on', oy oldidan 'in'.

scenes.title: Muloyim so‘rov formulalari
board: 'I would be grateful if you could…'

examples.t: I would be grateful if you could send the brochure.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri buyruq berib bo‘lmaydi — xat sizning madaniyatingizni ham ko‘rsatadi. 'Could you please confirm whether…' — eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan model. 'Would it be possible to defer my place…?' — imkoniyat haqida muloyim so‘rash. 'I would be grateful if you could…' — biroz rasmiyroq va juda muloyim. 'Further information regarding…' — ma’lumot so‘rashning rasmiy kirishi. Bu formulalar qabul xodimining javob berish istagini oshiradi.
scenes.say: Direct imperatives don't work in English letters — they signal poor culture. 'Could you please confirm whether…' is the workhorse. 'Would it be possible to defer my place…?' asks about feasibility politely. 'I would be grateful if you could…' is a shade more formal, very courteous. 'Further information regarding…' is the formal gateway for information requests. These frames measurably raise your response rate.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz xatida to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri buyruq — madaniyatsizlik belgisi. 'Could you please confirm whether…' — eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan model. 'Would it be possible to defer my place…?' — imkoniyatni muloyim so‘rash. 'I would be grateful if you could…' — biroz rasmiy, juda muloyim. 'Further information regarding…' — ma’lumot so‘rashning rasmiy kirishi. Bu formulalar javob olish ehtimolini oshiradi.

scenes.title: Namuna: follow-up xat
scenes.say_native: Ikki hafta javob yo‘qmi? Panikaga tushmang — follow-up yozing. Eski xatingizga topshiriq sifatida murojaat qiling, bir jumladan oshirmang.
scenes.say: Subject: Following up — Enquiry of 12 November. Dear Admissions Team, I wrote on 12 November about entry requirements for the MSc Data Science, September 2027 intake, and I have not yet received a reply. I would appreciate it if you could confirm whether my questions were received, and what the typical response time is. Kind regards, Dilnoza Karimova.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: Following up — 12-noyabr enquiry'si. Dear Admissions Team. 'I wrote on 12 November about entry requirements…' — 12-noyabrda MSc Data Science, September 2027 intake kirish talablari haqida yozgan edim, hali javob olmadim. 'I would appreciate it if you could confirm whether my questions were received…' — savollarim qabul qilinganmi va odatiy javob vaqti qancha ekanini tasdiqlab bersangiz minnatdor bo‘lardim. 'Kind regards' — yopilish.

scenes.title: Follow-up xat yozing
board: 2 hafta javob yo‘q deb tasavvur qiling
scenes.say_native: Tasavvur qiling: 12-noyabrda yuborgan xatingizga ikki hafta javob yo‘q. Follow-up xat yozing: mavzu, eski sana, bir muloyim savol — 'Could you confirm receipt?' Yetmish so‘zdan oshirmang. Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Imagine two weeks of silence after your email of 12 November. Draft the follow-up: subject, reference the earlier date, one polite question — for example, could you confirm receipt and the expected response time? Under seventy words. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Tasavvur qiling: 12-noyabr xatiga ikki haftalik sukunat. Follow-up yozing: mavzu, avvalgi sana, bitta muloyim savol — masalan, qabul qilinganini va kutilayotgan javob vaqtini tasdiqlay olasizmi? Yetmish so‘zdan oshmasin. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: follow-up odobi
scenes.say_native: Javoblar va odob qoidalari. Follow-up uchun eng kam kutish muddati — o‘n-to‘rt kun. Xatda faqat avvalgi sana va qisqa takror bo‘lsin — butun eski xatni qayta yopishtirmang. 'Urgent!!!' yoki 'Why no reply?!' — bunday xatlar qabul xodimida yomon taassurot qoldiradi. 'I would appreciate an update when convenient' — eng to‘g‘ri yo‘l. Agar yana ikki hafta jim bo‘lishsa, telefon qiling — bu normal amaliyot.
scenes.say: Answers and etiquette. Wait ten to fourteen days before following up. Keep it to the date plus one short recap — never paste the entire old email. No 'Urgent!!!', no sarcasm — they poison the relationship. Best line: 'I would appreciate an update when convenient.' If silence continues for two more weeks, a phone call is perfectly normal.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar va odob. Follow-up uchun kutish muddati — o‘n-to‘rt kun. Xatda faqat avvalgi sana va qisqa takror — butun eski xatni qayta yozmang. 'Urgent!!!' yoki kinoya — munosabatni buzadi. Eng to‘g‘ri ibora: 'I would appreciate an update when convenient.' Yana ikki hafta sukunat bo‘lsa, telefon qilish — normal holat.

scenes.title: Apply to vs apply for — 6 xato
board: ✗ 'apply for the university' → ✓ 'apply to the university'

examples.t: I would like to apply for the scholarship at Leeds.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek talabalari eng ko‘p qiladigan xatolar. Birinchi: 'apply to' — muassasaga, universitetga; 'apply for' — narsaga, stipendiya, viza, ishga. 'Apply for the university' — mutlaqo xato. Ikkinchi: maqola — 'I am a student', 'a' unutilganda jumla buziladi. Uchinchi: 'discuss about' emas, shunchaki 'discuss' — 'discuss the requirements'. To‘rtinchi: 'according to my opinion' mavjud emas — 'In my opinion' deyiladi. Beshinchi: 'I am interesting in' — 'I am interested in'. Oltinchi: 'more easier' — 'much easier'.
scenes.say: The six classic mistakes. One: 'apply to' an institution; 'apply for' a thing — a scholarship, a visa, a job. 'Apply for the university' is wrong. Two: the article — 'I am a student', never drop 'a'. Three: 'discuss' takes no preposition — 'discuss the requirements'. Four: 'according to my opinion' doesn't exist — 'in my opinion'. Five: 'I am interested in', not 'interesting in'. Six: 'much easier', not 'more easier'.
scenes.say_uz: Oltita klassik xato. Bir: 'apply to' — muassasaga; 'apply for' — narsaga: scholarship, viza, ish. 'Apply for the university' — xato. Ikki: maqola — 'I am a student'. Uch: 'discuss' old ko‘makchisiz — 'discuss the requirements'. To‘rt: 'according to my opinion' yo‘q — 'in my opinion'. Besh: 'I am interested in'. Olti: 'much easier', 'more easier' emas.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: ikki talaba muhokamasi
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglov. Ikki talaba — Dilnoza va Jasurbek — qayerga ariza topshirish haqida bahslashmoqda. Qaysi universitetni tanlashdi, nega va qanday shartlarda ekanligini aniqlang. Savollar keyin keladi.
scenes.say: Jasurbek: Dilnoza, have you decided? Student: Leeds for the MSc Data Science — good reputation, reasonable fees. Jasurbek: But the deadline is 30 June — three weeks away, and your IELTS is in two weeks. Student: I know. Leeds has a January intake too, but I'd rather start in September. Jasurbek: The scholarship? Student: They cover up to 40 percent — my grades should qualify. Jasurbek: Then do it — I'll check your documents tomorrow. Student: Thanks. I'll enquire tomorrow morning.
scenes.say_uz: Jasurbek: Dilnoza, qayerga ariza topshirishga qaror qilding? Student: Leeds — MSc Data Science, yaxshi obro‘, o‘rtacha to‘lov. Jasurbek: Lekin muddat 30-iyun — uch hafta qoldi, IELTSing esa ikki haftadan keyin. Student: Bilaman. Leeda January intake ham bor, lekin men September'da boshlashni xohlayman. Jasurbek: Stipendiya-chi? Student: Merit asosida 40 foizgacha; baholarim yetishi kerak. Jasurbek: Unda topshir. Hujjatlarni ertaga birga tekshiramiz. Student: Rahmat. Ertaga ertalab enquire yozaman.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol: Dilnoza qaysi dasturni tanladi? Nega aynan September intake? Stipendiya necha foizgacha qoplanadi? Jasurbek nima bilan yordam berishga rozi bo‘ldi? Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: which programme did Dilnoza choose? Two: why the September intake? Three: how much can the scholarship cover? Four: what did Jasurbek agree to help with? Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol: bir — Dilnoza qaysi dasturni tanladi? Ikki — nega September intake? Uch — stipendiya necha foizgacha? To‘rt — Jasurbek nima bilan yordam beradi? Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: bir — Leeds universitetining MSc Data Science dasturi. Ikki — u September'da boshlashni xohlaydi, January intake'ni rad etdi. Uch — merit stipendiya 40 foizgacha. To‘rt — Jasurbek ertaga hujjatlarni birga tekshirishga rozi bo‘ldi. Tinglashda har doim qarorga olib keladigan so‘zlarni tutib oling: 'I'd rather', 'Then do it', 'I'll help' — bular xulosani ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: Leeds, MSc Data Science. Two: she'd rather start in September, not January. Three: up to 40 percent. Four: he'll check her documents with her tomorrow. In listening, catch the decision markers: 'I'd rather', 'Then do it', 'I'll help' — they signal the conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: bir — Leeds, MSc Data Science. Ikki — u September'da boshlashni xohlaydi. Uch — 40 foizgacha. To‘rt — Jasurbek hujjatlarni tekshirishga yordam beradi. Tinglashda qaror markerlarini tutib oling: 'I'd rather', 'Then do it', 'I'll help' — bular xulosani bildiradi.

scenes.title: Pronunciation: schedule, enquire, diploma

examples.t: The scholarship schedule will be announced soon.
examples.uz: Stipendiya jadvali tez orada e’lon qilinadi.

scenes.say_native: To‘rttasi pronunciation. 'Schedule' — Britaniyada 'shed-yool', Amerikada 'sked-jool' — ikkovi ham tushuniladi, lekin britaniylashtiring. 'Enquire' — urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: en-KWY-er. 'Diploma' — stress ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: di-PLO-ma, 'diploma'ni birinchi bo‘g‘inda urmang. 'Scholarship' — birinchi bo‘g‘in stressda: SKOL-er-ship. Weak formlar: 'of', 'from', 'for' — xat jumlalarida yengil aytiladi.
scenes.say: Four pronunciation points. 'Schedule': UK says SHED-yool, the US says SKED-jool — both fine, but aim for the British form here. 'Enquire': stress the second syllable — en-KWY-er. 'Diploma': stress the second syllable — di-PLO-ma. 'Scholarship': stress the first — SKOL-er-ship. In fast speech, 'of', 'from' and 'for' reduce to schwa sounds.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta pronunciation. 'Schedule': UK — SHED-yool, US — SKED-jool; Britaniya shaklini tanlang. 'Enquire': urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda — en-KWY-er. 'Diploma': urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda — di-PLO-ma. 'Scholarship': birinchi bo‘g‘in — SKOL-er-ship. Tez nutqda 'of', 'from', 'for' schwa'ga aylanadi.

scenes.title: To‘liq enquiry: yakuniy mashq
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy yozish mashqi: to‘liq enquiry xatini og‘zaki aytib bering. Mavzu satri, salomlashish, ikki jumlalik tanishtiruv, uch savol — kirish talablari, stipendiya, muddat — va yopilish. Yigirma soniyada qisqa, ammo to‘liq xat aytib bering.
scenes.say: Final writing task: dictate a complete enquiry. Subject line, greeting, a two-sentence introduction, three questions — entry requirements, funding, deadline — and a formal closing. Twenty seconds: short but complete.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy yozish vazifasi: to‘liq enquiry'ni og‘zaki aytib bering. Mavzu satri, salom, ikki jumlalik tanishtiruv, uch savol — kirish talablari, moliyalashtirish, muddat — va rasmiy yopilish. Yigirma soniya: qisqa, ammo to‘liq.

scenes.title: Javoblar: o‘z-o‘zini baholash ro‘yxati
board: Savollar aniq va javob berishga osonmi?
scenes.say_native: Baholash ro‘yxati. Mavzu satrida dastur nomi va intake bormi — ha oltita-sakkiz so‘z. Birinchi jumla maqsadni ochadimi — 'I am writing to enquire…'. Har savol alohida jumladami — qabul xodimi ularni birma-bir javoblay oladimi. Yopilish rasmiymi — 'Kind regards' yoki 'Yours sincerely'. Va oxirgi savol: bu xatni yig‘ilishda ko‘rsatsa, uyalmaymanmi? Hamma bandiga 'ha' bo‘lsa — uy vazifasiga to‘liq tayyorsiz.
scenes.say: Self-check list. Subject line: six to eight words with programme plus intake? Opening sentence states the purpose — 'I am writing to enquire…'? Each question its own sentence, easy to answer one by one? Formal closing — 'Kind regards' or 'Yours sincerely'? And the final test: would you be comfortable showing this email in a meeting? All yes? Then you're ready for the homework.
scenes.say_uz: O‘z-o‘zini baholash. Mavzu satri: olti-sakkiz so‘z, dastur va intake bormi? Ochilish maqsadni ochadimi — 'I am writing to enquire…'? Har savol alohida jumlada, birma-bir javob berishga osonmi? Yopilish rasmiymi — 'Kind regards' yoki 'Yours sincerely'? Oxirgi test: bu xatni yig‘ilishda ko‘rsatishdan uyalmaymanmi? Hamma bandiga 'ha' — uy vazifasiga tayyorsiz.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
board: Lug‘at: programme, intake, tuition fee, scholarship
Xat: mavzu → kim → 3 savol → Kind regards
Muddat: no later than / by / ahead of
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Lug‘at: programme, intake, tuition fee, scholarship, conditional offer — beshtasi inglizcha o‘ylash darajasida. Hujjatlar: passport, transcript, diplom, IELTS, personal statement, tavsiyanomalar, CV — va ularning aksariyati tasdiqlanishi kerak. Xat: mavzu satri, qisqa tanishtiruv, uch savol, rasmiy yopilish. Muddatlar: 'no later than', 'by', 'ahead of' — va sana formati har doim so‘zlar bilan. Va oxirgi: 'apply to' universitetga, 'apply for' stipendiyaga.
scenes.say: Sum up. Vocabulary: programme, intake, tuition fee, scholarship, conditional offer — think in English. Documents: passport, transcript, degree, IELTS, personal statement, two references, CV — most need certifying. The enquiry: subject line, brief intro, three questions, formal closing. Deadlines: 'no later than', 'by', 'ahead of' — dates written in words. And the golden rule: 'apply to' a university, 'apply for' a scholarship.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa. Lug‘at: programme, intake, tuition fee, scholarship, conditional offer. Hujjatlar: passport, transcript, diplom, IELTS, personal statement, ikki tavsiyanoma, CV — aksariyati tasdiqlangan bo‘ladi. Enquiry: mavzu satri, qisqa kirish, uch savol, rasmiy yopilish. Muddatlar: 'no later than', 'by', 'ahead of' — sanalar so‘zlar bilan. Oltin qoida: universitetga 'apply to', stipendiyaga 'apply for'.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Keyingi dars: Grant va motivatsion xat
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: qabul bo‘limiga enquiry xat yozing. Mavzu satrida dastur nomi va intake; birinchi jumlada kim ekanligingiz; kamida uchta aniq savol — kirish talablari, stipendiya, oxirgi muddat; rasmiy yopilish. Xat yuz ellik so‘zdan oshmasin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: xat bir daqiqada o‘qiladi, har savol alohida jumla va javob berish oson. Keyingi darsda grant va motivatsion xatni o‘rganamiz — tuzilishi, yutuqlarni taqdim etish va ishontiruvchi, ammo kamtarona ohang. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: write an enquiry to an admissions office. Subject line with programme and intake; opening sentence introducing you; at least three clear questions — entry requirements, scholarship, deadline; a formal closing. Maximum one hundred and fifty words. Success test: readable in one minute, each question on its own line, easy to answer. Next lesson: grants and motivation letters — structure, presenting your achievements, and a persuasive yet modest tone. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: qabul bo‘limiga enquiry xat yozing. Mavzu satrida dastur va intake; birinchi jumlada kim ekanligingiz; kamida uchta aniq savol — kirish talablari, stipendiya, oxirgi muddat; rasmiy yopilish. Yuz ellik so‘zdan oshmasin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: bir daqiqada o‘qiladi, har savol alohida jumla, javob berish oson. Keyingi dars: grant va motivatsion xat — tuzilishi, yutuqlar, ishontiruvchi, ammo kamtarona ohang. Omad tilayman!

quiz.q: Which British spelling is used for a course of study?
quiz.why_uz: Britaniya imlosida 'programme' — kurs va o‘quv dasturi uchun; 'program' faqat kompyuter dasturi yoki Amerika inglizchasida ishlatiladi.

options: You have been fully accepted with no conditions
You will be admitted if you meet final conditions
You must pay the fee immediately
quiz.why_uz: Conditional offer — shartli qabul: yakuniy baholar yoki IELTS talabni qondirsa, joyingiz kafolatlanadi; to‘liqsiz ariza qabul qilinmaydi.

quiz.q: Which document proves your official academic grades?
quiz.why_uz: Transcript — rasmiy baholar qaydnomasi; passport shaxsni, CV tajribani, personal statement motivatsiyani tasdiqlaydi.
Apostille — Haaqa konvensiyasi mamlakatlari orasida hujjat haqligini xalqaro tasdiqlovchi muhr; adliya vazirligi orqali rasmiylashtiriladi.

quiz.q: Choose the correct phrase: I want to ___ the University of Leeds.
quiz.why_uz: 'Apply to' — muassasaga (universitet, kompaniya); 'apply for' — narsaga (stipendiya, ish, viza). O‘zbekchada ikkalasi ham 'ariza topshirish' deb tarjima qilinadi, lekin inglizchada farqi bor.

quiz.q: What does 'no later than 30 June' mean?
options: You may apply any time after 30 June
30 June is the absolute final day
quiz.why_uz: 'No later than' — eng oxirgi sana; 30 iyun kuni soat 23:59 gacha yetib borishi kerak, bir soniya kech bo‘lsa ariza rad etiladi.

quiz.q: Which date format is unambiguous in international correspondence?
quiz.why_uz: '8 November 2026' — oy so‘z bilan yozilganda chalkashuv bo‘lmaydi; 11/07 va 07/11 Britaniya va AQShda ikki xil o‘qiladi.

quiz.q: Which opening sentence is most appropriate for an enquiry email?
options: I want information about your course.
I am writing to enquire about the MSc entry requirements.
quiz.why_uz: 'I am writing to enquire about…' — rasmiy, aniq va muloyim; qolganlari buyruq yoki juda noaniq ohangda.

quiz.q: In a British context, which intake is the autumn cohort?
quiz.why_uz: Buyuk Britaniyada September intake — kuzgi to‘plam; fall/spring — Amerika atamalari.

quiz.q: How many questions should a strong enquiry email contain?
quiz.why_uz: Uchta aniq savol — kirish talablari, moliyalashtirish, muddat — javob berishga oson va professional; juda uzoq xatlarni hech kim o‘qimaydi.
